rules.build:
export ICU_CONFIG="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/icu-config"
if [ -e "/tools/bin/python3" ]; then export PYTHON="/tools/bin/python3" else export PYTHON="/usr/bin/python3" fi
cp -a "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3" cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3"
./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --with-history \ --with-icu \ --with-python="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3"
# HACK: this fixes a problem with lib path detection if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" != "/tools" ]; then find . -name "Makefile" -exec sed -i 's@-L/tools/lib@-L/usr/lib@g' '{}' ';' fi
make PYTHON_INCLUDES="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/python3.9" \ -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
rules.install: cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR/python3" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3"* find . -name "*.py" -exec \ python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('{}')" \;
